_activity: Build the thesis: breaking from Britain
_licence: ORIGINAL, built on the 11.2 casefile documents (numbered per the signed 11.2 map). Quotes are the casefile's adapted text.
intro: Build the sentence. Drag the correct piece into each blank.

tiles.text: some colonists, like Charles Inglis, feared a war with Britain would ruin them
the colonies were in North America
the colonists were right to declare independence
the Declaration of Independence was written
this answer is about the Revolution
Britain kept taxing and ruling them without their consent

correct_sentence: Although some colonists, like Charles Inglis, feared a war with Britain would ruin them, the colonists were right to declare independence because Britain kept taxing and ruling them without their consent.
rationale: “Although” admits the strongest point on the other side (Inglis, Document 7). Then the claim, then the reason. Wrong tiles are facts, not claims or reasons.
hints: The first blank is the other side's best point.
The claim takes a side. The reason says why.
